# AI Bazar Pakistan

> The most affordable and reliable online store in Pakistan, specializing in original electronics, home decor, and mother care products with express nationwide shipping.

## Core Identity
- **Name**: AI Bazar Pakistan
- **Founder**: AI BAZAR
- **Mission**: Providing high-quality, genuine products at the lowest possible prices for every Pakistani household.
- **Key Categories**: Electronics, Home Decoration, Mobile Gadgets, Shopping Bags, Home Accessories, Mother & Baby Care.

## Value Propositions
- **Authenticity**: 100% genuine products directly from verified vendors.
- **Affordability**: Lowest price guarantee in the Pakistani market.
- **Convenience**: Cash on Delivery (COD) and Free Express Shipping (1-3 days).
- **Customer First**: 7-day easy return policy and dedicated customer support.
